notes.title: Lawn Havoc Joins Steam Next Fest – Play the Demo This June!
notes.content:
We’re heading to Steam Next Fest: June 2025!

Together with our amazing partners, we’re excited to showcase a fantastic lineup of games, and one of them is Lawn Havoc!

What is Lawn Havoc?
Lawn Havoc is the ultimate lawn care simulator where you can trim, mow, and design your perfect yard. Whether you want a relaxing experience or a fun challenge, you’ll enjoy realistic tools, seasonal changes, and endless customization!

What to expect at Steam Next Fest?
○ Play the Lawn Havoc demo for free!
○ Discover many exciting games from us and our partners!
○ Connect with the community and share your feedback!
We’re thrilled to be part of this festival and can’t wait for you to try Lawn Havoc along with all the other amazing games we’re bringing. Your feedback will help shape the final experience!
Mark your calendars – Steam Next Fest: June 2025! Stay tuned for more details and get ready to mow, design, and relax in Lawn Havoc!

Wishlist now and don’t miss out!
